text: Ethics in AI is a growing concern as artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives. One major issue is bias, because AI systems can make unfair decisions if they are trained on poor data. Fairness means these systems should treat all people equally, regardless of their background. Privacy is also important, since AI often collects and uses personal information. In addition, transparency matters: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Responsible AI development brings all these ideas together, ensuring that companies and governments build technology that respects human rights and earns public trust.
